cards.belonging: Expand vocabulary and nurture a sense of belonging to Brazilian roots.
cards.identity: Strengthen the relationship between language, identity, and Brazilian culture in Canada.
cards.language: Encourage the development of speaking, reading, and writing skills in Portuguese.
cards.memory: Create positive emotional memories connected to Portuguese while respecting each child's pace.

mission.quote: We prioritize making sure every child is happy at Oficina Curumim.

pedagogy.body: In a playful and participatory environment, children engage in activities related to Brazilian folklore, notable figures, historical facts, art, literature, and storytelling. Each activity proposal is guided by a study theme.

cta.body: Join our community and create a deep connection to Brazilian roots.
cta.title: Register your Curumim today!

indiozinhos.description: Activities that bring children closer to reading and writing through music, short texts, storytelling, games, dramatic play, and the creation of short written texts.
indiozinhos.name: INDIOZINHOS

macaquinhos.description: Activities that introduce reading and writing practices, songs, nursery rhymes, storytelling, body awareness, rhymes, games, dramatization, and image reading.
macaquinhos.name: MACAQUINHOS

oncinhas.description: Activities focused on oral language, songs, storytelling and read-alouds, body awareness, Brazilian games, and encouragement to speak Portuguese.
oncinhas.name: ONCINHAS

tatuzinhos.description: Activities centred on oral language, songs, storytelling and read-alouds, body awareness, play, sounds, and different kinds of stimulation (visual, tactile, auditory, motor).
tatuzinhos.name: TATUZINHOS

tucanos.description: Activities focused on understanding the structure and basic functioning of the language and using it in oral communication, reading, and writing situations. Formal production through a variety of text genres.
tucanos.name: TUCANOS

hero.subtitle: Each stage is unique. We divide our groups to explore the full potential of each phase while respecting every child's individual pace of development.

birthdays.description: We celebrate every birthday with songs in Portuguese and cards made by classmates, encouraging joy and interaction in the group.
birthdays.name: Birthdays

carnival.description: Playful activities about the history and cultural expressions of Brazil’s different regions. We organize a big celebration with music, dance, and traditional costumes.
carnival.name: Carnival

community.description: Participation in public events in Vancouver, sharing our work with the wider community and keeping our traditions alive.
community.name: Brazilian Community

juneParty.description: One of the most anticipated moments of the year. Organized by families and staff, it brings the best of Sao Joao traditions into the Canadian context.
juneParty.name: June Festival

plh.description: A day to connect Portuguese as a Heritage Language initiatives around the world. We host themed rooms with educational activities that reinforce belonging and Brazilian identity.
plh.name: PHL
plh.subtitle: Portuguese as a Heritage Language

yearEnd.description: A special presentation by the children for their families, celebrating the end of the year with music and pride in our language.
yearEnd.name: Year-End Celebration

about.bodyPrimary: Oficina Curumim is a non-profit organization whose mission is to encourage the use of spoken and written Portuguese while strengthening connections to Brazilian culture for Brazilian families across Greater Vancouver.
about.bodySecondary: Brazilian cultural, artistic, and social elements are used as the context for the learning experiences in our groups.

babies.description: First steps in Portuguese through songs, stories, and sensory play.
babies.title: Baby Group

children.description: Oral language development and an introduction to writing through play and storytelling.
children.title: Children’s Group

kids.description: A deeper experience with Portuguese through reading, writing, and immersion in Brazilian culture.
kids.title: Kids Group

classes.subtitle: We offer groups for children from 6 months to 12 years old. Explore the activities and learning focus of each one.

events.body: We host cultural events all year long at Oficina Curumim. Explore our annual calendar.

jobs.body: We are always looking for volunteers and partners who are passionate about education and culture.

library.description: Families volunteer to organize, catalogue, lend, and review the collection. Each child is encouraged to choose one book per week and read it at home with their family.
